summary: RandomStatusSegment (prototypes.ts) has no n/nRange and builders.inflictRandom/attach drop opts.n, so inflictRandom('allyFirstN'|'enemyLastN'|'enemyFirstN') always hits one unit. resolveTargetsTracked already reads segment.n at runtime; only the type + builder copy are missing.
